general.title: Emporiqa
general.description: Sync products and pages, test your connection, and manage integration settings.

infoBanner.quickSetup: Quick Setup: 1. Click Connect to Emporiqa below to link your store in one click, or enter your Store ID and Webhook Secret manually and save. 2. Run your first sync from the Sync tab.

connect.connectHelp: One click connects this shop to your Emporiqa account and fills in the credentials automatically.
connect.initiateError: Could not start the connection to Emporiqa. Please try again.

callback.title: Connect to Emporiqa
callback.successMessage: Your shop is now connected. The credentials have been saved automatically.
callback.errorGeneric: The connection could not be completed. Please try again.
callback.missingParams: The callback is missing required parameters. Please start the connection again from the settings page.

settings.saveError: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
settings.loadError: Failed to load settings. Showing defaults, please check your connection and reload.

connection.title: Connection
connection.storeIdHelp: Find it in your Emporiqa dashboard at Settings → Integration → Integration overview.
connection.webhookSecretHelp: Find it in your Emporiqa dashboard at Settings → Integration → Integration overview.
connection.errorGeneric: Connection test failed. Check your Store ID and Webhook Secret.
connection.saveFirst: Save your settings before testing the connection.
connection.noProductFound: No active products found to test with. Using test payload.
connection.orderTrackingUrlHelp: Copy this URL into your Emporiqa dashboard under Settings, Integration, Order tracking.
connection.clockSkew: Your server clock is off by {minutes} minutes; Emporiqa refuses signatures more than 5 minutes off. Ask your host to enable NTP.
connection.headlessChannels: Not synced (headless sales channel): {names}. Shopware creates no product page addresses (SEO URLs) for headless channels, so the chat could not link to products there; only Storefront sales channels are synced. The chat widget comes with the Storefront theme; on a frontend Shopware does not render, add it with the embed code: https://emporiqa.com/docs/widget-embedding/

syncSettings.brandSourceHelp: Select which property group to use as the brand source, or keep the default to use the product manufacturer.

orderTracking.legacyHelp: Replaced by the Order status rule above. To switch it off, first remove its address in your Emporiqa dashboard (Settings > Integration > For your developer > Order tracking API URL), then switch this off and click Save.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.webhookUrlHelp: Only change this if you run a custom Emporiqa instance.
advanced.enabledLanguagesHelp: Select which languages to include in synced data. All selected languages are sent in each event. The chat widget is hidden on storefronts whose language is not selected.
advanced.enabledLanguagesEmpty: No storefront languages found. Add a domain to a storefront sales channel first.
advanced.enabledSalesChannelsHelp: Select which sales channels to sync to Emporiqa. Unselected channels are left out of product and page syncs and the chat widget is not shown on their storefronts.
advanced.enabledSalesChannelsRequired: Select at least one sales channel.

welcome.title: Connected to Emporiqa. One more step.
welcome.body: Send your products and pages to Emporiqa so the chat has something to recommend. Everything is sent in batches in the background, so you can close this tab once it starts.

sync.title: Sync Dashboard
sync.syncProductsDescription: Send the full product catalog to Emporiqa.
sync.syncPagesDescription: Send all CMS landing pages to Emporiqa.
sync.syncAllDescription: Send both products and pages in one operation.

driver.nothingToSync: Nothing to sync, no active products or pages found.
driver.skippedIncomplete: Skipped completing the {entity} session: one or more batches failed. No items were deleted on Emporiqa.
driver.finishedWithErrors: Sync finished with errors. Check the log for details.

cli.title: CLI Commands
cli.description: These commands are available in the Shopware CLI. Each sync command also supports a --dry-run flag.

configLink.manage: Manage the synced sales channels and languages and send your catalogue to Emporiqa from the Emporiqa page.
configLink.description: Open the Emporiqa page to connect your shop in one click, choose the synced sales channels and languages and send your catalogue.

rules.title: Ready-made rules
rules.intro: Rules tell the chat what to do when a shopper asks for something specific. The rule below reads your Shopware orders through this plugin. Click Open in Emporiqa to test it and switch it on there. Rules that do not need your shop, such as return requests, are added in Emporiqa under Settings > Rules.
rules.suggestLegacyOff: The Order status rule is on, so the old order tracking under Advanced is no longer needed. First remove its address in your Emporiqa dashboard (Settings > Integration > For your developer > Order tracking API URL), then switch it off under Advanced and click Save.
rules.addressHelp: Emporiqa fills this in for you when you add the Order status rule. If it ever asks for the address, use this one.
rules.addressHttps: Open this page over https to see the address: Emporiqa only calls https addresses.
rules.orderStatusDescription: Answers "Where is my order?" from your Shopware orders. A shopper signed in to your shop only gives the order number; a guest also gives the email used for the order.
rules.stateHelp: On and Not added show what Emporiqa said at your last connect or Test connection (Sync tab). Run Test connection after changing a rule to refresh them.
